system.description:
Allows a character to reroll all dice for an action. You may choose from any result (original or rerolled).

  • Level 1: 2 rerolls per session
  • Level 2: 4 rerolls per session
  • Level 3: 6 rerolls per session
  • Level 4: 8 rerolls per session
  • Level 5: 10 rerolls per session
  • Level 6: 12 rerolls per session
